purpose: Execute the atomic translate-body operation within the MA-14 boundary: Root-only current DesignBody translation through Move.Translate. Component/occurrence editing, copy, and rotation are excluded.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires translate-body and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: A current root-part DesignBody accepted by require_live_body.

inputs.name: delta_mm
inputs.description: Finite signed displacement vector in millimetres.

inputs.name: bbox_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: Tolerance for matching the translated bounding box.

inputs.name: volume_tolerance_mm3
inputs.description: Tolerance for matching the pre-translation volume.

preconditions: body is a current root DesignBody and passes assert_closed.
delta_mm is finite; both tolerances are finite and nonnegative.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The unique current root body whose bounds and volume match the translated expectation; zero delta returns the supplied body.

postconditions: For nonzero delta, Move.Translate does not report failure and exactly one refreshed current body matches the pre-bounds plus delta_mm within bbox_tolerance_mm and preserves volume within volume_tolerance_mm3.
For zero delta, the action returns the supplied current body without calling Move.Translate.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic translate-body operation within the MA-14 boundary: Root-only current DesignBody translation through Move.Translate. Component/occurrence editing, copy, and rotation are excluded. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: current_bodies() is re-enumerated after a nonzero mutation.

failure_modes.condition: require_live_body or vector/tolerance validation raises ValueError.
failure_modes.detection: require_live_body or vector/tolerance validation raises ValueError.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: Move.Translate reports failure or no unique expected body is found after mutation.
failure_modes.detection: Move.Translate reports failure or no unique expected body is found after mutation.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use and retain only a clean run-owned state.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate a current root body and supply finite values.
Inspect the root document, discard/repair the mutated model, and rerun; no rollback is implemented.
